name: mask by a random multiple of the public key; recover by a secret multiplication that keeps the noise small enough to round away
mechanism: the public key is a quotient of two secret polynomials with tiny coefficients; encrypt by adding a random small multiple of it to the message; multiplying the result by the secret denominator cancels the random part into something with small coefficients, so reducing modulo the small modulus and rounding recovers the message

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'NTRUEncrypt' in section Computer science / Cryptography:

fails_when: rare decryption failures when the noise exceeds the rounding margin
